На основание чл. 21, ал. 6 от ЗОП, Обособена позиция № 2 „Доставки на пакетирани хранителни продукти и варива“ с прогнозна стойност 19 685,83 евро без вкл. ДДС (общо 19,62% от прогнозната стойност за изпълнение на цялата обществена поръчка), планирана като обособена позиция в настоящата поръчка, ще бъде възложена по реда, валиден за индивидуалната й прогнозна стойност - чрез „директно възлагане“ на основание чл. 20, ал. 4, т. 3 от ЗОП, тъй като стойността на съответната обособена позиция - 19 685,83 евро без ДДС не надхвърля сумата от 156 464 лв., които превалутирани в евро се равняват на 79 998,77 евро и същевременно прогнозната стойност на обособената позиция, възложена по този начин, не надхвърля 20 на сто от общата прогнозна стойност на поръчката без ДДС, което е 20 067,84 евро без вкл. ДДС. Възложителят взема решение да възложи Обособена позиция № 2 „Доставки на пакетирани хранителни продукти и варива” по реда, валиден за индивидуалната й прогнозна стойност, на основание и при спазване на изискванията на чл. 21, ал. 6 от Закона за обществените поръчки – чрез „директно възлагане“ по смисъла на чл. 20, ал. 4, т. 3 от ЗОП. ДДС съответно 80 653,36 евро (осемдесет хиляди шестстотин петдесет и три евро и тридесет и шест евроцента) без вкл. ДДС, която е остатъчната прогнозна и лимитна стойност на обособена позиция № 1 „Доставки на пресни плодове и зеленчуци“. Предвид гореизложеното, предметът на поръчката, която се възлага с настоящата „открита процедура“ е „Доставки на хранителни продукти - пресни плодове и зеленчуци за нуждите на ДГ „Червената шапчица“ - град Пловдив“. II. В предмета на обществената поръчка са включени и доставки на био хранителни продукти от съответната продуктова група, които следва да са произведени съгласно изискванията на Регламент (ЕС) 2018/848 на Европейския парламент и на Съвета от 30 май 2018 г. относно биологичното производство и етикетирането на биологични продукти и за отмяна на Регламент (ЕО) № 834/2007 на Съвета (ОВ, L 150 от 14.06.2018 г.) (Регламент (ЕС) 2018/848) и Наредба № 5 от 2018 г. за прилагане на правилата на биологично производство, етикетиране и контрол и за издаване на разрешение за контролна дейност за спазване на правилата на биологичното производство, както и за последващ официален надзор върху контролиращите лица (ДВ, бр. 75 от 2018 г.). Биологичните храни, предлагани в детските заведения, трябва да са произведени, преработени и/или дистрибутирани от лица, вписани в регистъра по чл. 16а, ал. 1, т. 1 от Закона за прилагане на Общата организация на пазарите на земеделски продукти на Европейския съюз. III. Срокът на действие на договора за обществена поръчка за доставки на пресни плодове и зеленчуци е 24 (двадесет и четири) календарни месеца, считано от датата на влизането му в сила или до изчерпване на стойността на договора за обществена поръчка, което от двете условия настъпи по-рано. При изтичане на срока на действие на договора за обществена поръчка, но неизчерпване на стойността му и при наличие на финансови средства по договора, срокът на същия може да се продължи до изчерпване на стойността му, но не повече от 3 (три) календарни месеца, при наличие на съгласие между Възложителя и Изпълнителя за прилагане на посочената опция чрез подписване на допълнително писмено споразумение към договора за обществена поръчка на основание чл. 116, ал. 1, т. 1 от ЗОП. Договорът за обществена поръчка влиза в сила, след изтичане срока на действие на договора за доставки на пресни плодове и зеленчуци, действащ към датата на обявяване на поръчката. За точната дата на влизане в сила на договора за обществена поръчка, изпълнителят ще бъде уведомен чрез отправяне на Възлагателно писмо от Възложителя до Изпълнителя, в което е посочена началната дата на изпълнение на договора за възлагане на обществена поръчка. title: Freedom 250 Reception and Fireworks Event
description: Please note this solicitation is not ready to be issued as of this date. The U.S. Consulate General in Sapporo, Japan, will launch the solicitation on the SAM.gov website when it is available. This is a firm-fixed-price contract for the Contractor to provide comprehensive event management, venue, hospitality, entertainment, fireworks, permitting, transportation, parking, photography/videography, technical, safety, and on-site coordination services for a Freedom 250 commemorative event on February 5, 2027. The event will consist of a two-hour reception at Nouvelle Pousse at Okurayama followed immediately by a 20-minute professional fireworks display beginning at 8:00 p.m. The contractor shall coordinate all elements necessary to deliver a safe, professional, and well-integrated event, including coordination with Nouvelle Pousse, Sapporo City, Hokkaido Prefecture, local police and other relevant authorities. The event occurs during the Sapporo Snow Festival period; therefore, the contractor shall account for any additional permitting, traffic, access, crowd-management, venue, environmental, or operational requirements associated with the festival. All responsible sources may submit a quotation, which will be considered. The Government may award the contract based on the initial offers without discussion. The resultant contract will be a firm-fixed-price contract. All U.S. Contractors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) database https://www.sam.gov prior to submitting a quotation, in accordance with FAR provision 52.204-7. Therefore, prospective quoters must complete registration before submitting their quotations. Overseas Contractors are recommended to register in the System for Award Management (SAM) database https://www.sam.gov prior to contract award. This opportunity is subject to 52.229-12 - Tax on Certain Foreign Procurements (FEB 2021) Electronic Submission/Responses: This opportunity allows for electronic responses. Please submit your quotation prior to the specified response date and time. Please ensure that your submission does not exceed 15MB. If your submission exceeds this limit, you may need to send multiple emails.

title: Market Research Notice - General Market Research for Locally Available Materials and Welding Capabilities (Japan)
description: ***Market Research Notice � Request for Information*** Subject: General Market Research for Locally Available Materials and Welding Capabilities Reference (a): NAVSEA Technical Publication S9074-AQ-GIB-010/248 Rev 1 (Requirements for Welding and Brazing Procedure and Performance Qualification) Enclosure (1): Locally Available Material Suggestions Sheet 1. General Notice This Request for Information (RFI) is issued by Naval Supply Systems Command (NAVSUP) Fleet Logistics Center Yokosuka (FLCY) on behalf of U.S. Naval Ship Repair Facility and Japan Regional Maintenance Center (SRF-JRMC), Yokosuka, Japan, solely for information, planning, and general market research. This announcement does not constitute a Request for Proposals (RFP), an Invitation for Bids (IFB), a Request for Quotations (RFQ), or an announcement of an impending solicitation, and it shall not be construed as a commitment, promise, or obligation by the United States (U.S.) Government to enter into any contract or issue any future competitive procurement. The Government is strictly gathering market intelligence, and no RFP will be issued as a result of this market research notice. Participation in this inquiry is entirely voluntary. The Government will not pay or reimburse respondents for any costs incurred, directly or indirectly, in compiling, preparing, reviewing, or submitting responses, technical specifications, or supplemental documentation. Any responses received will become the property of the U.S. Navy and will not be returned. 2. Background and Purpose SRF-JRMC operates forward-deployed ship maintenance, repair, and modernization facilities across the U.S. Seventh Fleet operational theater, primarily based at Yokosuka and Sasebo, Japan. Executing continuous, emergent, and scheduled maintenance on U.S. Navy surface vessels and expeditionary craft demands rigorous adherence to Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA) technical standards. A primary operational challenge in overseas expeditionary and forward-deployed maintenance is the administrative and supply-chain burden associated with procuring military-specification base materials and welding consumables for procedure qualification records (PQR) and welder performance qualification. To mitigate these operational constraints, SRF-JRMC seeks to evaluate regional industrial welding capabilities, commercial classification standards, and Japanese domestic supply inventories that may satisfy or align with the mandatory technical requirements established in NAVSEA Technical Publication S9074-AQ-GIB-010/248 Rev 1. 3. Market Research Objectives SRF-JRMC�s market research focuses on two primary objectives: Objective A - Locally Available Materials: Identify viable regional materials certified under recognized standards such as Japanese Industrial Standards (JIS), Nippon Kaiji Kyokai (ClassNK), or other equivalent bodies that may be technically evaluated for incorporation into existing S-Groups (base materials, Table 7-1) or A-Groups (filler materials, Table 7-2) in accordance with Reference (a), thereby facilitating local procurement for procedure and personnel qualification. Objective B - Existing Industry Partner Welding Capabilities: Assess the scope and maturity of existing industry partner welding programs and commercial certifications (Class NK, JIS) that may support compliance through the alternative qualification provisions of Reference (a), specifically Paragraph 4.2.2 (Certification of Qualification Testing and Other Agency Qualifications) and Paragraph 5.2.4 (Alternative Qualification Methods). 4. Requested Information from Industry Partners Interested maritime and ship repair contractors are requested to provide technical data addressing either or both areas below: A. Recommended Locally Available Materials (Objective A): Industry partners are requested to recommend commercially stocked base metals and welding consumables to be evaluated as potential substitutes for U.S. Military specifications. For each recommended material, provide the following details: Suggested Grouping: Recommended S-Group (base metal, Table 7-1) or A-Group (filler metal, Table 7-2) classification under Reference (a). Technical Specification: Copy of the applicable JIS or other relevant material specification sheet Operational Context Optional): Brief description of shipboard systems or structures in which the material is currently used in Japanese maritime operations. Submissions may be organized using Enclosure (1). B. Existing Welding Program Capabilities (Objective B): To assess opportunities to reduce qualification burdens consistent with Reference (a) Paragraphs 4.2.2 and 5.2.4, industry partners are requested to provide: a. A list of existing welding procedure qualification records/reports currently maintained by your facility, including the associated certifying authority ((e.g. JIS, ClassNK, American Bureau of Shipping [ABS], Americal Society of Mechanical Engineers [ASME]) and specific base material(s), filler material(s), welding processes, and thickness/position ranges certified. b. A list of existing written procedures, instructions or documents addressing the following areas: Welder Performance Qualification: A summary description of your company�s system for qualifying welders and welding operators, including governing standards (JIS, ClassNK, ABS, ASME). Welding Consumable Control: Documentation or standard operating instructions governing the receipt, storage, handling, baking, and issuance of welding consumables (particularly low-hydrogen electrodes and bare wires). Execution, Oversight, and Surveillance of production welding work: Written procedures, work instructions, or quality manuals detailing shop-floor surveillance, inspection hold points, in-process quality control, and NDT examination for shipboard production work. 6. Proprietary Data and Business-Sensitive Information Respondents are strongly discouraged from submitting proprietary or business-sensitive data in response to this market research announcement. If an industry partner must submit proprietary information to demonstrate technical capability, each proprietary page or data item must be clearly marked as �PROPRIETARY�. Any unmarked data will be considered non-proprietary and may be used without restriction. 7. Response Submission Instructions Interested maritime industry partners and commercial shipyards are requested to submit their responses electronically via email no later than 20 November 2026, 1600 Japan Standard Time (JST). Submissions may be prepared in Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, or Adobe PDF format, and responses written in either English or Japanese are accepted, though English is preferred for formal technical records. Submissions should reference the RFI notice �RFI: General Market Research for Locally Available Materials and Commercial Welding Capabilities� in the email subject line. title: Germany – Construction-related services – Erstellung von Baulärmgutachten und - monitoring für zwei Neubauprojekte zu ministeriellen Zwecken auf dem Postblockareal, Direktion Berlin
description: Die Bundesanstalt für Immobilienaufgaben (BImA) beabsichtigt als Auftraggeberin (AG), auf der Liegenschaft „Postblock Nord“ (= PBN) an der Wilhelmstraße/Leipziger Straße im Berliner Stadtbezirk Mitte ein neues Verwaltungsgebäude für ministerielle Zwecke zu errichten. Auf der angrenzenden Liegenschaft „Postblock Süd“ (= PBS) sollen ein Ministerialgebäude und ein Wohngebäude errichtet werden. Das Postblockareal ist ein städtisches Quartier in Berlin, das durch die Wilhelm-/ Leipziger-/ Mauer- und Zimmerstraße begrenzt wird. Die Gesamtfläche liegt im Bereich der Entwicklungsmaßnahme „Hauptstadt Berlin – Parlaments- und Regierungsviertel“. Es ist eines der letzten großen Entwicklungspotentiale für die Bundesregierung in Berlin-Mitte. Dort steht eine fast durchgängig zusammenhängende Baufläche von ca. 25.000 m² zur Verfügung, die etwa zur Hälfte jeweils auf die Bereiche des PBN (13.284 m²) und PBS (12.379 m²) entfällt. Die beiden Grundstücksflächen werden nur durch den vornehmlich als Fußweg und zur Versorgungsdurchfahrt genutzten Buchhändlerweg getrennt. Die Generalplanungsleistungen für die Projekte wurden jeweils im Anschluss an europaweit bekannt gemachte Wettbewerbe an die Staab Architekten GmbH (PBN) und die ARGE Schenker Salvi Weber ZT GmbH Franz und Sue ZT GmbH (PBS) vergeben. Weitere Fachplanungsleistungen wurden in gesonderten Verfahren beauftragt. Derzeit wird für das Projekt PBN aktuell ein europaweites ÖPP-Vergabeverfahren durchgeführt. Die Konzeptions- und Vorbereitungsphase ist abgeschlossen, das Verfahren befindet sich in der Phase des Teilnahmewettbewerbs. Die Beauftragung des ÖPP-Auftragnehmers ist nach derzeitigem Stand für Ende 2027 vorgesehen. Das Projekt PBS befindet sich aktuell in der Entwurfsplanung. Gegenstand des vorliegenden Vergabeverfahrens ist die Vergabe von Leistungen zum Leistungsbild “Baulärmgutachten und -monitoring” im Zusammenhang mit der Realisierung der beiden Bundesprojekte auf dem Postblockareal, konkret bestehend aus den Leistungen "Baulärmgutachten mit Baulärmprognose, Aufnahme der Bestandssituation, Lärmminderungsmaßnahmen" und "Begleitung der Bauausführung". Die auftragsgegenständlichen Leistungen werden durch die AG projektbezogen und zeitlich versetzt abgerufen. Grund für diese Trennung ist der zeitliche Vorsprung und die Datenlage (Bauablauf) des früher gestarteten Projekts PBN. Die Lärmschutzmaßnahmen müssen auf die Bauphasen beider Projekte ausgelegt sein, um eine möglichst lärmreduzierende Wirkung zu erzielen.

title: Auswertung VDM
description: Auswertung Verkehrsdatenmanagement - Verkehrsmonitoring: Im Zeitraum 2027 bis 2031 sollen die Verkehrsdaten des bayerischen Verkehrsdatenmanagements kontinuierlich geprüft, ausgewertet und aufbereitet werden. Hierzu übernimmt der Auftragnehmer monatlich die Rohdaten der automatischen Dauerzählstellen, führt Plausibilitäts- und Qualitätsprüfungen durch und berücksichtigt bekannte längerfristige Ausfälle. Auf Basis der Daten werden typische Ganglinien und Zählstellengruppen abgeleitet sowie Verkehrsmengen, Jahresganglinien und Geschwindigkeitsdaten aufbereitet. Die Ergebnisse sind für den Auftraggeber und die Bundesanstalt für Straßenwesen (BASt) bereitzustellen. Ergänzend werden monatliche Verfügbarkeits-, Monats-, Tages- und Stundenauswertungen sowie jährliche Gesamtauswertungen erstellt. Die Bearbeitung umfasst 2027 zunächst 182 und ab 2028 voraussichtlich 208 Dauerzählstellen. Im Rahmen des Verkehrsmonitorings sind jährlich die Daten von rund 2.000 Zählstellen auf Plausibilität zu prüfen und durch eine ergänzende Kontrolle der Dauerzählstellendaten abzusichern. Zudem werden Hochrechnungsfaktoren für temporäre und manuelle Zählungen (TM/MZ) ermittelt, die erhobenen Verkehrsdaten hochgerechnet und die Verkehrswerte von rund 7.300 Zählstellen jährlich fortgeschrieben. Weiterhin sind Ergebnistabellen für die Straßenverkehrszählung zu erstellen sowie längengewichtete DTV-Mittelwerte und die Jahresfahrleistung zu berechnen. Sämtliche Ergebnisse sind entsprechend den fachlichen Vorgaben strukturiert, nachvollziehbar und termingerecht aufzubereiten.

title: Jätevesimädätteen poiskuljettaminen
description: Jätevesimädätteen poiskuljettaminen Hankinta koskee jätevesimädätteen poiskuljettamista Metsäsairila Oy:n alueella (Kiertotaloudenkatu 18, 50800 Mikkeli) toimivan yhtiön omistaman biojalostamon varastosäiliöstä. Mädätteen noutoon tarvitaan imuauto, joka päästöluokituksiltaan täyttää Euro VI -kriteerit. Tarjousasiakirjaan on ladattava vapaamuotoinen tiedosto, josta ilmenevät perustiedot palvelun tuottamiseen käytettävästä kalustosta (merkki, vm, euroluokitus, säiliön tilavuus, akselien lkm, päästöt). Mädäte on orgaanista maanparannusainetta, joka täyttää Ruokaviraston sille lannoitekäyttöön asettamat vaatimukset. Mädätettä ei ole separoitu ja sen kuiva-ainepitoisuus on noin 11,5 %. Mädätteen tuotanto on jatkuvaa ja sitä syntyy noin 3 800 - 5 500 tonnia vuodessa. Tuorein, vuoden 2025 lopun näytteistä koostettu tuoteseloste on lisätty tämän tietopyynnön liiteasiakirjaksi. Tuoreempaa tuoteselostetta ei ole, koska reaktori on ollut huoltotoimien vuoksi poissa tuotantokäytöstä kuluneen kesän ajan. Mädätettä syntyy jatkuvasti, joten sen noutokin on jatkuvatoimista. Mädätteen poiskuljetus tapahtuu tilauksesta, josta palvelun tarjoajalla on 1 viikko aikaa noutaa tuote varastosäiliöstä. Varastosäiliö, jonka vetoisuus on noin 750 t mädätettä, ajetaan tyhjäksi yhdellä kertaa tai toimitaan muulla, yhteisesti sovitulla toimintatavalla. Palvelun tuottajan tulee täyttää kaikki tarjouspyyntöön liittyvät ja mädätteen noudosta aiheutuvat kustannukset. Vastuu tuotteesta ja sen hallinta siirtyvät palvelun tuottajalle, kun se on siirretty varastosäiliöstä imuautoon. Palvelu on oltava tarjolla heti sopimuskauden alkaessa.,

title: Etablering, drift og vedlikehold av døgnhvileplass langs E134/E18 Kongsberg-Asker
description: Statens vegvesen har behov for ca. 100 oppstillingsplasser på strekningen E134 Kongsberg–Drammen og E18 Drammen–Asker. Det er estimert et behov på ca. 70 oppstillingsplasser på E18 Drammen–Asker og ca. 30 oppstillingsplasser på E134 Kongsberg–Drammen. Oppdragsgiver forbeholder seg retten til å justere fordelingen noe mellom strekningene innenfor totalen basert på tilbudt løsning og tilgjengelige arealer. Det kan være aktuelt å inngå kontrakt med flere leverandører og/eller dele anskaffelsen opp i ulike delkontrakter. Hver enkelt døgnhvileplass skal minimum ha oppstillingsplasser til 15 vogntog og skal inneholde serviceanlegg med toalett, dusj og ladestasjoner. Ellers skal døgnhvileplassen oppfylle de skal-krav som er opplistet i punkt 3.2. Oppdragsgiver foretrekker store døgnhvileplasser. Døgnhvileplassen skal være klar til åpning senest 24 måneder etter at kontrakten er signert og kontrakten gjelder i 10 år fra åpningstidspunktet. Oppdragsgiver har opsjon på å forlenge avtalen med 1+1 år, slik at total mulig leieperiode blir 12 år. Ladeinfrastrukturen skal være ferdig utbygd og i drift I henhold til punkt 3.2 t. Det vil bli avholdt elektronisk tilbudskonferanse på Teams den 21.092026 klokka 12:00. Påmelding til tilbudskonferansen gjøres ved å sende navn og e-postadresse via kommunikasjonskanalen (melding) i KGV innen 18.09.2026 klokka 12:00.

title: TO-26-01 Rehabilitering og utvidelse av pipeorgel i Vingelen kirke
description: Bakgrunn og formål Vingelen kirke har et pipeorgel fra 1963 levert av Norsk orgel- og harmoniumfabrikk. Instrumentet har behov for omfattende teknisk og klanglig rehabilitering for å sikre videre drift og funksjonalitet i mange år fremover. Samtidig ønsker oppdragsgiver å videreutvikle orgelet ved å tilføre nye stemmer og styrke instrumentets musikalske og liturgiske bruksverdi. Anskaffelsens formål er å rehabilitere eksisterende orgel, restaurere nødvendige tekniske komponenter, utbedre slitasje og lekkasjer, samt utvide instrumentet innenfor de rammer som er fastsatt for prosjektet. Det er et mål å bevare og videreføre orgelets eksisterende klanglige karakter, samtidig som instrumentets allsidighet og kvalitet styrkes gjennom nye orgeltekniske løsninger og eventuelt gjenbruk av historiske elementer fra det tidligere Landrog-orgelet. Se for øvrig vedlagte dokument Prosjektbeskrivelse og kravspesifikasjon.
